STYLE: First 8 bars: solo soft thin 8-bit digital keyboard strikes ONE SINGLE PITCH slowly and evenly; SAME pitch, length and level, with silence between strikes. No pitch changes, melody, ornaments, chords, arpeggios or accompaniment. Keep this pulse underneath; quiet bass, then a second texture enter separately. ONLY THEN introduce an original memorable, deeply sad hook. Its 8-bit/16-bit game-like voice stays central throughout. Warm 16-bit harmonies grow around it; punchy big-beat drums arrive LATER. Bittersweet electronica, 125 BPM, 4/4, Eb major, around six minutes. Gradually widen the same hook with major-minor color, never replacing its chip voice. Briefly strip layers away; an uneasy low-bass passage builds tension before the SAME hook returns in thick instrumental harmonies for a cathartic peak. Exhilarating rhythm, sorrowful melody; patient layers, emotional repetition. No vocals.
EXCLUDE: intro pitch changes or phrases, early full-band entrance, vocals, crowd cheers/claps/chants/room bleed, arcade sound effects, cheerful jingles, replacement of the chip lead, supersaws
TITLE: A Light Left On
